technique_name: Construct an argument in support of universal basic income.
description: Universal basic income (UBI) is a policy proposal that provides a regular, unconditional cash payment to all citizens. UBI has the potential to reduce poverty, improve public health and wellbeing, and create a more secure, prosperous, and equitable society. UBI can be funded through a variety of means such as a financial transaction tax, carbon tax, or other taxes. UBI can help to reduce poverty and inequalities, reduce working hours and improve job security, and help to fund core public service
